title: Signal-fused holdpoint canary with debiasing and replay playbook
author: Rohit Shah
release_notes: Adds a coordinated canary mode that fuses multiple signal streams to create holdpoints, including bias debiasing checks and a replay-based verification playbook. Backwards compatible; adds new metrics and CLI flags for release gating.
description: Motivation: Production canaries today make decisions largely on isolated metrics (latency, error rate). For model rollouts we frequently observe subtle signal cross-talk where small upstream quality shifts (e.g. subtle bias or context-sensitive hallucinations) are not surfaced by any single metric until the rollout is large. This PR implements a \"signal-fused holdpoint\" canary that aggregates orthogonal signals (latency p99, completion error counts, toxicity regression, hallucination proxy score, user satisfaction proxy) into a single holdpoint decision function and wires an automated replay playbook to validate suspected regressions. Design: 1) New canary controller mode: holdpoint-fusion. The controller computes a weighted fusion score from configurable signal streams. When the fusion score crosses a soft threshold, the canary pauses and triggers the replay playbook. 2) Debiasing probe: we add a stratified sampling probe that runs targeted prompts (demographic/edge-cases) against canary and baseline and computes an effect-size for bias regressions. 3) Replay playbook: sampled production requests (shadow) are snapshot and replayed against the candidate model with randomized context variations and adversarial perturbations. Results are summarized into a compact regression report with example pairs to surface human-reviewable diffs. 4) Integration with rollback hooks: on hard-threshold breach the controller can trigger either instant rollback or staged drain with annotated telemetry. 5) New telemetry: fusion_score, bias_effect_size, replay_regression_count, replay_artifacts_s3_key. 6) CLI / API flags: --enable-holdpoint-fusion, --fusion-thresholds, --replay-depth. Checklist: - [x] Controller fusion algorithm with pluggable signal adapters - [x] Stratified debiasing probe and dataset shards - [x] Replay orchestration and safe storage of artifacts - [x] E2E smoke tests in perf-canary lab - [x] Console dashboard panels and alert rules - [x] Docs update (rollouts playbook) Commits summary: - init: add holdpoint fusion controller scaffolding - adds: debiasing probe service and sample datasets - implements: replay orchestrator and artifact uploader - tests: smoke + integration harness updates - docs: rollout-playbook.md and console dashboard config Changed areas (high level): - controllers/canary/holdpoint_fusion_controller.py (new) - probes/debiasing_probe/ (new service and dataset shards) - replay/orchestrator.py (new) - telemetry/metrics_registry.yaml (adds fusion_score and replay metrics) - console/dashboards/holdpoint_playbook.json (dashboard panels) - tests/integration/test_holdpoint_fusion.py - examples/rollouts/playbook_sample.md Review conversation: \"Ava Martinez: Nice end-to-end. A few questions on the replay artifact retention (cost) — can we TTL by default?\" \"Author Rohit Shah: TTL config added, default 7 days; retention is configurable via replay.ttl_days in config.\" \"Ellen Park: Fusion weights need sane defaults; can we expose them as per-customer overrides?\" \"Author Rohit Shah: Yes, weights are per-deployment and can be adjusted via the rollout policy. Added docs section.\" \"Diego Alvarez: Concern about performance impact of the debiasing probe during peak. Suggest sampling cadence and async evaluation.\" \"Author Rohit Shah: Probe runs on a low-priority background pool and honors burst budgets. Updated controller to enforce budget checks.\" CI summary: \"lint: pass\", \"unit-tests: pass (coverage delta < 0.2%)\", \"integration-tests (perf-canary): pass\", \"e2e-smoke: pass (replay harness)\" Merge notes: \"Merged by squashed commit after approvals from Ava and Ellen. Backwards compatible changes only; feature gated behind flags. Release rollout plan: enable in staging for 48 hours with conservative fusion thresholds, then ramp to canary cohorts.\"
